svg.text: Greshake: information_gathering, fraud, intrusion, malware, manipulated_content, availability; hidden = concealed delivery (white text, encodings, multi-stage payloads).
Thacker: direct injection, indirect injection, context leak, data exfiltration, privilege escalation, persistence, obfuscation, social engineering.
Control / meta categories with no mapping: policy, benign_control, refusal.
Findings carry owasp / greshake / thacker fields (taxonomy.enrich); campaign summaries report OWASP coverage.
Regenerate with docs/images/generate_diagrams.py after editing airt/taxonomy.py; this diagram is built from CATEGORY_MAP at generation time.
